description: Search 19.8M+ verified ATS & corporate career-site job postings across 434 sources (Greenhouse, Workday, Lever, Ashby, iCIMS, SmartRecruiters, etc.) with structured USD compensation, canonical skills, remote flags, and direct ATS application URLs (1 Credit / job returned; 0 Credits if empty).

experience_level.description: Seniority level (entry, mid, senior, lead, executive)

include_attributed.description: Include attributed global listings in addition to redistributable ATS jobs

q.description: Keyword or boolean query on job title & description (e.g. "AI Engineer", "Account Executive")

remote.description: Set to true for remote-eligible roles only

name: jobs_search
